newsitem.title: USA: Metropolitan Health in deal with Fla co.
newsitem.headline: Metropolitan Health in deal with Fla co.

text.p: Metropolitan Health Networks Inc's MetBilling Group Inc said Tuesday it entered into a contract to provide all emergency room patient billing for Emergency Care Specialists Inc of Miami.
The company said expects more than $500,000 in annual revenue from the deal.
The company also said it plans to acquire all the assets of Dr. David Glickman PA, of Hialeah, Fla. The purchase will be made through a combination of cash and stock.
The company did not disclose terms of the deal.
In connection with the acquisition, the company said Glickman, a family practitioner, will enter into a five-year employment deal to provide medical services to the Metropolitan medical group.
